threeQuestionStructure.question1: canonicalNamingDecision — Does electric_range remain the canonical identifier or rename to fuel-neutral range_oven?
threeQuestionStructure.question2: templateRoutingDecision — How do gas_range, induction, dual_fuel, and electric_range templates route to the shared functional contract?
threeQuestionStructure.question3: historicalReferencePolicy — What happens to existing electric_range references across the codebase?
threeQuestionStructure.governanceRule: Do not bundle naming with routing — each decision has independent outcomes and human approval.

cumulativeFitEvidence.significance: Same frozen functional model subjected to four materially different heating implementations without canonical mutation — fit experiment complete; remaining work is organizational.

canonicalNamingDecision.question: Does electric_range remain an appropriate canonical identifier, or should the functional family be renamed to a fuel-neutral identifier such as range_oven?
canonicalNamingDecision.framing: Rename proposal — NOT an automatic consequence of CG-11/12/13 fit tests.

KEEP_ELECTRIC_RANGE.label: Keep electric_range as canonical id
KEEP_ELECTRIC_RANGE.description: Frozen rev1 file and id remain; fuel diversity absorbed via fit-test evidence and platform vocabulary without organizational rename.

RENAME_TO_RANGE_OVEN.label: Rename canonical family to range_oven
RENAME_TO_RANGE_OVEN.description: Fuel-neutral organizational identifier; explicit compatibility/alias record so existing references do not silently break.

aliasRecordRequired.note: Alias preserves runtime and historical resolution — not a silent string replace

DEFER_RENAME.label: Defer rename decision
DEFER_RENAME.description: Proceed with template routing and normalization under electric_range id; revisit rename after compounding evidence.

canonicalNamingDecision.approvedRationale: Same frozen functional contract survived electric, gas, induction, and dual-fuel with zero divergence — electric_range is a misleading organizational name for what the contract represents.
canonicalNamingDecision.implementationNote: Non-destructive migration via implementation gate — range_oven primary with electric_range legacy alias; do not mutate CG-10 freeze artifact or rewrite fit-test historical record.

templateRoutingDecision.question: How should implementation templates (gas_range, induction, dual_fuel, electric_range) route while sharing one functional canonical contract?
templateRoutingDecision.coreRule: Template routing selects the appropriate implementation/template overlay while resolving against the same functional canonical contract — do not create four competing canonical ontologies.

proposedRoutingModel.diagram: gas_range | induction_range | dual_fuel_range | electric_range → shared functional contract (range_oven or electric_range per naming decision)
